brief.audience: A person commissioning a one-page document
brief.job: Show the grid, the two weights, and the three colors
brief.narrative: Name the law, then the grid, then what is refused

content.title: The Grid
content.lead: Every edge sits on the grid. Type is Helvetica, Neue Haas Grotesk, or Inter, in regular and bold only.

sections.heading: Measure
sections.body: Twelve columns, four-millimetre gutters. Text is flush left and ragged right.

sections.heading: Ink
sections.body: Black, rice-white, and one red, #DA291C. Flat ink only.

content.close: Leave a field of the page empty.
